spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:10:7: command demo: flag "mode": a multi-value `default` needs a repeatable type, and this one is string; each element is seeded as a separate occurrence, which a single-valued input has nowhere to put. Declare the type as a list (e.g. []string) or a map, or give a single scalar default
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:19:7: command demo: flag "retries": a multi-value `default` needs a repeatable type, and this one is int; each element is seeded as a separate occurrence, which a single-valued input has nowhere to put. Declare the type as a list (e.g. []string) or a map, or give a single scalar default
spec: .rotini.spec.yaml:27:7: command demo: flag "tags": every element of a multi-value `default` must be a scalar, and one is a list; each element is seeded as one occurrence and coerced through the input's element type, so there is nowhere for a nested list or map to go
